analysisSubject: Baby for charts and AI review
unassigned: Only records with no baby assigned
analysisScope: Uses only your own records for the selected baby. Records made by family members are excluded. The mood chart shows your own mood. Select below if you also want to send your mood and recovery records to AI.
analysisUnavailable: The selected baby could not be verified. Reload or choose again.
analysisProfile: Attach my birth method and average sleep time
analysisProfileNotice: Baby age and feeding preferences from your account profile are excluded because they are not linked to the selected baby.
reviewConflict: This review task changed after you started entering information. Your input is retained. Check the saved version before continuing.
reloadReview: Discard this internal note's input and use the saved version
confirmReloadReview: Discard this internal note's input and confirmation and use the saved version? Public directory edits are kept.
correctTimer: Check save result, then correct input
timerCorrection: No saved record was found at this moment. You can correct the input while keeping the start and end times. The same save reference is retained in case the original save finishes later. If it has already saved, open that record to make corrections.
timerExisting: A record exists for this save reference but differs from the input. Open the saved record to check and correct it.
